long_biography.plain_text:
Steve Rigby joined his father's business in 1991 after leaving school at 16. He moved through the family group as it expanded beyond its SCC technology-services core, building companies and taking responsibility for strategy, finance and investments. He now serves as chief executive of Rigby Group and sits on boards across its technology, property and investment operations.

Rigby's career combines active management with second-generation stewardship. The group identifies him and his brother James as shareholders, while a family-business account describes the founding generation's 2024 transfer into trust. Steve is also one of the family trustees. He chairs the Rigby Foundation and Family Business UK and previously led Place2Be's development board.
